senses.en: having a big effect or value

ex.en: It is important to write the date on the form.
ex.zh: 在表格上写日期很重要。

ex.en: Clean drinking water is more important to a growing town than another bright shopping sign.
ex.zh: 对一个发展中的城镇来说，干净的饮用水比又一块闪亮的商店招牌更重要。

tip: It is important for sb to do，不要漏掉 for 或 to。

senses.en: a room or building where art is shown

ex.en: The gallery is free on Sunday.
ex.zh: 画廊周日免费。

ex.en: A gallery that closes before the last bus has already chosen its visitors.
ex.zh: 在末班车之前就关门的画廊，其实已经选定了它的观众。

tip: gallery 也可指楼座。

senses.en: very unpleasant

ex.en: The smell from the bin was disgusting.
ex.zh: 桶里的气味令人厌恶。

ex.en: Calling a person disgusting is not a joke the class should keep.
ex.zh: 说一个人令人厌恶，不是班级该保留的笑话。

col: a disgusting smell｜令人厌恶的气味
tip: disgusting 可以形容事物。用在人身上会伤人。

senses.en: an oily substance in food and in the body
having a lot of flesh or oil

ex.en: This soup has less fat than the fried dish.
ex.zh: 这汤比那道油炸菜脂肪少。

ex.en: Health class should talk about fat in food without mocking how a classmate looks.
ex.zh: 健康课应当讨论食物里的脂肪，而不是嘲笑同学的样子。

tip: fat 作形容词是“胖的；肥的”。描述人时要注意礼貌。

senses.en: to walk with regular steps, often in a group
a walk by a group, or the third month when capitalised

ex.en: The band will march onto the field.
ex.zh: 乐队将列队走上场地。

ex.en: People march when a decision about their street is made without asking them.
ex.zh: 当关于他们街道的决定没有询问他们就做出时，人们会游行。

tip: March 大写是三月；march 小写是行进。不要在句子里混用大小写。

senses.en: related to the spirit or to religion

ex.en: The song had a spiritual meaning for some students.
ex.zh: 这首歌对一些学生有精神上的意义。

ex.en: A school can discuss spiritual life without choosing one faith for everyone.
ex.zh: 学校可以讨论精神生活，而不为每个人选定一种信仰。

tip: spirit 已在本库。spiritual 不是“含酒精的”，那是 spirits 的另一个意思，本条不用。

senses.en: the act of selling

ex.en: The book sale is on Friday.
ex.zh: 书展义卖在周五。

ex.en: The sale of public land beside a school should not ignore the playground it replaces.
ex.zh: 出售学校旁边的公共土地，不该忽略它取代的操场。

tip: for sale 是待售；on sale 常指降价。

senses.en: at any time, or every time

ex.en: Come whenever you are free.
ex.zh: 你什么时候有空就来。

ex.en: Whenever the river rises, the same two classrooms flood first.
ex.zh: 每当河水上涨，同样的两间教室最先进水。

tip: whenever 引导时间从句。口语里也可表示“究竟什么时候”。

senses.en: to keep something for a particular person or purpose
a supply kept back, or a protected area

ex.en: Please reserve two seats on the bus.
ex.zh: 请在公交上订两个座位。

ex.en: A library that can reserve a book for a student who lives far away is doing its job.
ex.zh: 能为住得远的学生留一本书的图书馆，是在做它的工作。

tip: reserve 作名词是储备或保护区。预订的名词常用 reservation。

senses.en: the last part

ex.en: The ending of the story surprised us.
ex.zh: 故事的结局让我们吃惊。

ex.en: A happy ending in a film about a flood can hide the work that comes after the water leaves.
ex.zh: 洪水电影里的快乐结局，可能掩盖水退之后还要做的工作。

tip: ending 是名词。动词结束用 end。

senses.en: to agree with and help, or to provide what is needed
help or approval

ex.en: Our class supports the book-sharing plan.
ex.zh: 我们班支持图书共享计划。

ex.en: Parents cannot support a long school day if the buses stop before the last lesson ends.
ex.zh: 如果公交车在最后一节课结束前就停运，父母就无法支持过长的在校时间。

col: support sb in｜在某方面支持
tip: support 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，不加 to。

senses.en: a building where people live

ex.en: Their house is next to the post office.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在邮局旁边。

ex.en: A house built on cheap wetland may cost less at first and much more after the first flood.
ex.zh: 建在廉价湿地上的房子，起初可能更便宜，第一次洪水之后却贵得多。

tip: house 是建筑物；home 是家的感觉或所在。

senses.en: an idea or feeling about something

ex.en: The first impression was the broken clock.
ex.zh: 第一印象是那块坏钟。

ex.en: An impression is not a measurement.
ex.zh: 印象不是测量。

tip: impression 可数。

senses.en: a polite word for a woman

ex.en: The lady at the desk helped us.
ex.zh: 柜台的女士帮助了我们。

ex.en: A lady who works the night shift still needs a safe way home.
ex.zh: 上夜班的女士仍然需要一条安全的回家路。

col: ladies and gentlemen｜女士们先生们
tip: lady 的复数是 ladies。正式场合可用，但 woman 更中性。

senses.en: a large musical instrument with keys

ex.en: The piano is in the hall.
ex.zh: 钢琴在礼堂里。

ex.en: A piano that nobody may touch teaches less than ten minutes of practice.
ex.zh: 谁也不许碰的钢琴，比十分钟练习教得少。

tip: play the piano 要加 the。

senses.en: a game played by two teams kicking a ball; American name

ex.en: Soccer practice is at four.
ex.zh: 足球训练在四点。

ex.en: In this atlas, soccer is the same game many students call football.
ex.zh: 在本库里，soccer 就是许多学生称为 football 的那场运动。

tip: 英式足球在美国常叫 soccer。football 已在本库。play soccer 不加 the。

senses.en: to decide after thinking; to end

ex.en: We can conclude that practice helps.
ex.zh: 我们可以得出结论：练习有帮助。

senses.en: to have an influence on
to cause someone to feel a strong emotion

ex.en: Noise can affect your ability to sleep.
ex.zh: 噪音会影响你的睡眠能力。

ex.en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。

col: deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人
tip: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

senses.en: to make a bell sound, or to call by phone
a sound of a bell, or a circle of metal

ex.en: The bell will ring in two minutes.
ex.zh: 铃将在两分钟后响。

ex.en: Please ring the office if the bus has not left by four.
ex.zh: 如果公交四点还没走，请给办公室打电话。

col: ring sb up｜给某人打电话
give sb a ring｜给某人打电话
tip: ring 的过去式是 rang，过去分词是 rung。作名词还可指戒指或环形物。

senses.en: a place where people buy and sell

ex.en: We buy fruit at the morning market.
ex.zh: 我们在早市买水果。

ex.en: A local market keeps money in the town, while a distant supermarket sends it away.
ex.zh: 本地市场把钱留在镇上，而远处的超市把钱送走。

tip: market 作动词是“推销”。

senses.en: something that helps you
A useful or positive feature of something.

ex.en: Speaking two languages is an advantage.
ex.zh: 会说两种语言是一种优势。

ex.en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。

col: have an advantage over｜比……有优势
tip: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

senses.en: the cloud produced by something burning
to produce smoke, or to breathe in smoke from a cigarette

ex.en: Smoke from the lab set off the alarm.
ex.zh: 实验室的烟触发了警报。

ex.en: The school rule says students must not smoke, and it also says where adults may stand.
ex.zh: 校规写明学生不得吸烟，也写明成年人可以站在哪里。

tip: smoke 作动词是冒烟或吸烟。表里这一行的音标是 smile，本库不用。

senses.en: a group of things of the same type

ex.en: Put the books in the right category.
ex.zh: 把书放进正确的类别。

ex.en: A category called other often hides the students the form forgot.
ex.zh: 名为“其他”的类别，常常藏着表格忘掉的学生。

col: fall into a category｜属于一类
tip: category 可数。复数 categories。

senses.en: a raised area of land, smaller than a mountain

ex.en: The path goes over a low hill.
ex.zh: 这条小路翻过一座矮山。

ex.en: Houses on a steep hill need a plan for rain before the path becomes a stream.
ex.zh: 陡坡上的房子需要在小路变成溪流之前就有下雨的方案。

tip: hill 比 mountain 小。山脚用 at the foot of the hill。

senses.en: to ride a bicycle
a series that repeats, or a bicycle

ex.en: I cycle to school when it is dry.
ex.zh: 天气干的时候我骑自行车上学。

ex.en: A safe place to cycle matters as much as a lesson about the environment.
ex.zh: 一个能安全骑车的地方，和一节关于环境的课一样重要。

tip: cycle 作名词可以是自行车，也可以是循环。

senses.en: after the expected time
after the right time

ex.en: I was late because the bus did not come.
ex.zh: 我迟到了，因为公交没来。

ex.en: Late buses leave students waiting in the dark, which is a safety problem as well as a delay.
ex.zh: 晚点的公交让学生在黑暗中等待，这既是延误，也是安全问题。

tip: late 可作形容词或副词。lately 是“最近”，不是“迟到地”。

senses.en: the main city, a large letter, or money for business
of a large letter, or of money

ex.en: Beijing is the capital of China.
ex.zh: 北京是中国的首都。

ex.en: Write the capital letter at the start of the sentence, and check the name of the city.
ex.zh: 句首要写大写字母，并核对城市的名字。

tip: capital 的三个常见义是首都、大写和资本，要看搭配。

senses.en: something heavy that is carried
to put a load onto something

ex.en: The load was too heavy for one person.
ex.zh: 这批货一个人搬太重。

ex.en: A lighter load of homework before a match does not lower the standard of the term.
ex.zh: 比赛前少一点作业，并不会降低整个学期的标准。

tip: load 作动词是装载。workload 是工作量。

senses.en: how old someone is, or a period of history

ex.en: What is the age of the oldest student in the club?
ex.zh: 社团里年龄最大的学生几岁？

ex.en: In an age of cheap photos, it is harder to know which picture shows a real event.
ex.zh: 在照片便宜的时代，更难知道哪张照片展示的是真事。

tip: at the age of 后接数字。同龄用 of the same age。

senses.en: a sweet baked food

ex.en: The cake is for the class, not for one person.
ex.zh: 蛋糕是给全班的，不是给一个人的。

ex.en: A cake at a school fair should list nuts on the label.
ex.zh: 学校义卖上的蛋糕应当在标签上写明坚果。

col: a piece of cake｜一块蛋糕；很容易的事
tip: a piece of cake 也可比喻很容易。cake 作一块时可数。

senses.en: a picture made with a camera
to take a photograph

ex.en: The photograph is on the wall.
ex.zh: 照片在墙上。

ex.en: A photograph of a student should not be posted without permission.
ex.zh: 学生的照片不应当未经允许发布。

tip: photographer 是本批的另一词。photograph 作动词是拍照。

senses.en: careful thought

ex.en: Cost is one consideration.
ex.zh: 费用是考虑因素之一。

ex.en: Consideration for the night worker belongs in the bus plan.
ex.zh: 对夜班工人的考虑应当写进公交计划。

tip: 动词 consider 已在本库。

senses.en: something that can be heard
to seem when heard
in good condition, or sensible

ex.en: I heard a sound in the hall.
ex.zh: 我听见大厅里有声音。

ex.en: The sound of night traffic keeps students awake even when the classroom itself is quiet.
ex.zh: 夜间交通的声音会让学生睡不着，即使教室本身很安静。

tip: sound 作连系动词后接形容词：sound good，不接 well 表示“听起来好”（身体好除外）。

senses.en: a unit of weight

ex.en: The truck carried a ton of rice.
ex.zh: 卡车运了一吨米。

ex.en: A ton on a poster is not a measurement until someone writes the method.
ex.zh: 海报上的“一吨”在有人写下方法之前还不是测量。

tip: a ton of 口语里也可表示大量。表里这一行的音标是 tomorrow，本库不用。

senses.en: a wish to know more, or an advantage
to make someone want to know more

ex.en: She has an interest in local history.
ex.zh: 她对本地历史有兴趣。

ex.en: A company interest in cheap land is not the same as a town interest in clean water.
ex.zh: 公司对廉价土地的利益，不等于城镇对干净水的利益。

tip: interesting 修饰事物；interested 修饰人。

senses.en: to ask for money; to accuse
An amount of money requested for goods or services.
Put electrical energy into a battery or device.

ex.en: Hotels often charge extra for breakfast.
ex.zh: 酒店常对早餐额外收费。

ex.en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
ex.zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。

tip: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

senses.en: no longer alive

ex.en: The plant is dead because nobody watered it.
ex.zh: 这棵植物死了，因为没人浇水。

ex.en: A river that looks dead in summer may recover if factories stop pouring waste at night.
ex.zh: 夏天看起来死气沉沉的河，如果工厂停止夜里排污，仍可能恢复。

tip: dead 是形容词；die 是动词；death 是名词。

senses.en: to have a particular meaning, or to intend
not generous, or unkind

ex.en: What does this word mean in the passage?
ex.zh: 这个词在文章里是什么意思？

ex.en: A low score does not mean a student cannot learn; it may mean the test ignored what they can do.
ex.zh: 低分并不意味着学生学不会；它可能意味着考试忽略了他们会做的事。

tip: mean to do 是打算；mean doing 是意味着。

senses.en: images during sleep, or a strong hope

ex.en: Her dream is to study medicine.
ex.zh: 她的梦想是学医。

ex.en: A school that only praises high scores can make a quieter dream look less serious than it is.
ex.zh: 只夸奖高分的学校，会让一个较安静的梦想显得不够重要。

col: a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip: dream 作动词是“做梦”或“梦想”，后常接 of doing。

senses.en: the smallest unit of a living thing, or a small room

ex.en: We drew a plant cell in biology.
ex.zh: 我们在生物课上画了植物细胞。

ex.en: A biology lesson on the cell is clearer when students can compare it with a room in a building.
ex.zh: 如果学生能把细胞和楼里的一个房间相比，这一课会更清楚。

tip: cell 在生物课是细胞，在监狱语境是单人牢房。手机是 cell phone。

senses.en: happening at even times, or usual

ex.en: She takes a regular bus at seven.
ex.zh: 她七点坐固定的一班公交。

ex.en: Regular sleep helps attention more than one long night of revision.
ex.zh: 规律的睡眠比考前熬一个长夜更有助于注意力。

tip: regular 的副词是 regularly。

senses.en: of the Pacific Ocean

ex.en: The map colours the Pacific in blue.
ex.zh: 地图把太平洋涂成蓝色。

ex.en: A lesson about the Pacific should name the coasts, not only the water.
ex.zh: 关于太平洋的课应当写到海岸，而不只是水。

tip: Pacific 作海洋名要大写。作形容词“和平的”时可以小写，本条用考纲里的太平洋义。

senses.en: to make something not closed, or to start a business
not closed, or public

ex.en: Open the window if the room feels hot.
ex.zh: 如果房间闷，就把窗户打开。

ex.en: Shops that open late help workers who cannot buy food before their shift ends.
ex.zh: 营业到很晚的商店，帮助那些下班前买不到食物的工人。

tip: open 作形容词是“开着的”；be open 表示状态，不要说 be opened 表示日常开着。

senses.en: in or to another country

ex.en: Her uncle works abroad.
ex.zh: 她叔叔在国外工作。

ex.en: News from abroad should still name the source.
ex.zh: 来自国外的新闻仍然应当写明来源。

tip: abroad 是副词，前面不加 in。

senses.en: in or of the south

ex.en: The southern gate is closer to the bus stop.
ex.zh: 南门离公交站更近。

ex.en: Southern cities face long summers, so school timetables may start earlier in the day.
ex.zh: 南方城市夏天很长，所以课程表可能把课排得更早。

tip: southern 是形容词。名词用 south。

senses.en: to get something wanted or useful
something gained

ex.en: She hopes to gain experience in the library.
ex.zh: 她希望在图书馆获得经验。

ex.en: A city can gain parks and still lose old trees if the plan only counts new ones.
ex.zh: 如果方案只计算新种的树，一座城市可以新增公园，同时失去老树。

tip: gain 强调经过努力得到。也可作名词“收益”。

senses.en: matching the facts

ex.en: Is it true that the museum is free today?
ex.zh: 博物馆今天免费，这是真的吗？

ex.en: A story can sound true and still leave out the people who were harmed.
ex.zh: 一个故事可以听起来真实，却仍然漏掉受到伤害的人。

tip: come true 的主语是梦想或预言，不用被动。true 强调符合事实。

senses.en: a system or a set for watching broadcasts

ex.en: They watched the match on television.
ex.zh: 他们在电视上看了比赛。

ex.en: Television can show a distant classroom, and it still cannot ask the student a question.
ex.zh: 电视可以展示一间遥远的教室，它仍然不能向学生提问。

tip: television 是全称，TV 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 telegraph，本库不用。

senses.en: an alcoholic drink made from grain

ex.en: The school fair does not sell beer.
ex.zh: 学校义卖不卖啤酒。

ex.en: A town festival that offers beer should also offer a clear rule for students under age.
ex.zh: 提供啤酒的城镇节日，也应当给未成年学生一条清楚的规定。

col: a glass of beer｜一杯啤酒
tip: beer 作种类时可数：a beer。学校场景里它是成人饮料，不是给学生的奖品。

senses.en: to be present at, or to look after

ex.en: All students attend the morning meeting.
ex.zh: 所有学生参加晨会。

ex.en: Students who cannot attend still need the notes the same day.
ex.zh: 不能出席的学生，当天仍然需要笔记。

tip: attend 后直接接活动，不加 to 表示出席。attend to 才是处理或照料。

senses.en: related to the skills of a particular subject

ex.en: The manual is too technical for the first week.
ex.zh: 这份说明书对第一周来说太技术化了。

ex.en: A technical fault in the exam system should not be recorded as a student mistake.
ex.zh: 考试系统的技术故障不应当记成学生的错误。

tip: technical 是形容词。名词技术常用 technology 或 technique。

senses.en: a strong feeling of being angry

ex.en: His anger did not fix the clock.
ex.zh: 他的愤怒没有修好钟。

ex.en: Anger at a late bus is fair, and a written time is more useful.
ex.zh: 对晚点公交的愤怒是合理的，写下来的时间更有用。

tip: angry 已在本库。anger 是名词，通常不可数。

senses.en: the act of sharing information

ex.en: Clear communication saved the trip.
ex.zh: 清楚的沟通救了这次出行。

ex.en: Communication between the school and the bus company should not depend on one phone.
ex.zh: 学校和公交公司之间的沟通不应当只靠一部电话。

tip: communication 通常不可数。a communication 可指一封正式函件。

senses.en: a feeling that worry has gone, or help for people in trouble

ex.en: It was a relief when the bus arrived.
ex.zh: 公交到了，大家松了一口气。

ex.en: Flood relief should include a dry room, not only a speech.
ex.zh: 洪水救济应当包括一间干的房间，而不只是一篇讲话。

col: to one relief｜令某人欣慰的是
tip: relief 通常不可数。a relief 表示一件令人宽慰的事。

senses.en: the state of being dark

ex.en: The path was in darkness.
ex.zh: 小路笼罩在黑暗里。

ex.en: Darkness at the crossing is a reason to add a light.
ex.zh: 路口的黑暗是加一盏灯的理由。

tip: dark 已在本库。darkness 通常不可数。

senses.en: an agreement, or an amount
to handle, or to do business

ex.en: We made a deal to share the cleaning.
ex.zh: 我们说好轮流打扫。

ex.en: A great deal of plastic leaves a school every day if the canteen still uses single-use boxes.
ex.zh: 如果食堂仍用一次性盒子，学校每天都会送出大量塑料。

tip: a great deal of 后接不可数名词。deal with 表示处理。

senses.en: a sudden bright light, or a very short time

ex.en: A flash of light crossed the yard.
ex.zh: 一道闪光穿过院子。

ex.en: In a flash the notice was wrong, and the class had already left.
ex.zh: 转眼通知就错了，班级却已经走了。

tip: flash 作动词是闪光。新闻里的 flash 也可指快讯。

senses.en: a way of doing something

ex.en: The bus is our only means of getting to the museum.
ex.zh: 公交是我们去博物馆的唯一办法。

ex.en: A means of checking news matters when a false photo can travel faster than a correction.
ex.zh: 当一张假照片比更正传得更快时，核对新闻的方法就很重要。

tip: means 单复数同形。a means 是一种方法，谓语用单数。

senses.en: sweet food made with sugar; especially American

ex.en: The candy is mostly sugar.
ex.zh: 这糖果主要是糖。

ex.en: Candy that hides nuts should say so on the label.
ex.zh: 藏着坚果的糖果应当在标签上写明。

tip: candy 是美式。英式常用 sweet，已在本库。作物质名词通常不可数。

senses.en: the act of going in, or one item in a list

ex.en: Entry is free for students.
ex.zh: 学生免费入场。

ex.en: The last entry in the log should say who locked the lab.
ex.zh: 记录的最后一条应当写明谁锁了实验室。

tip: 动词进入是 enter，已在本库。entry 也可指参赛作品或词典的词条。

senses.en: for everyone, or known to people in general
people in general

ex.en: The public library is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆周日开放。

ex.en: Public money should be easy to trace, from the tax office to the classroom it is meant to support.
ex.zh: 公共资金应该易于追踪，从税务部门一直到它本应支持的教室。

tip: the public 表示公众，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: American spelling of grey
the colour gray

ex.en: The sky is gray this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上天空是灰色的。

ex.en: A gray area in the rule should be written in one sentence.
ex.zh: 规定里的灰色地带应当用一句话写清。

tip: gray 是美式，grey 是英式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留。

senses.en: studying again, or a report judging something
to study again, or to judge

ex.en: We did a review of last week's words.
ex.zh: 我们复习了上周的单词。

ex.en: A review of a new road should include the people who walk it, not only the engineers.
ex.zh: 对新路的评议应该包括走这条路的人，而不只是工程师。

tip: review 作动词是“复习”或“评论”。

senses.en: a main public road

ex.en: The highway does not pass the school.
ex.zh: 这条公路不经过学校。

ex.en: A highway without a crossing is a wall for the student who walks.
ex.zh: 没有斑马线的公路，对步行的学生来说是一堵墙。

tip: highway 可数。information highway 比喻信息通道。

senses.en: soldiers as a group

ex.en: The history text mentions troops only as part of the war.
ex.zh: 历史课文提到部队，只是把它当作战争的一部分。

ex.en: News about troops should name the place and the date, not invent a method.
ex.zh: 关于部队的新闻应当写地点和日期，而不是编造方法。

tip: troops 是复数。单数一名士兵不用 troop 来指人，troop 常指一队。本条不写军事操作。

senses.en: to need, or to demand

ex.en: The form requires a parent signature.
ex.zh: 这张表需要家长签字。

ex.en: A lab rule that requires goggles protects eyes, and it only works if the goggles are actually there.
ex.zh: 要求戴护目镜的实验室规定能保护眼睛，但前提是护目镜真的在那儿。

col: require sb to do｜要求某人做
tip: require 后接名词或 sb to do。不说 require to do。

senses.en: a large business company

ex.en: The corporation funds the school library.
ex.zh: 这家公司资助学校图书馆。

ex.en: A corporation that uses the school name in an ad should say so on the poster.
ex.zh: 在广告里使用校名的公司，应当在海报上写明。

tip: corporation 比 firm 更常指大公司。可数。

senses.en: a penalty for doing something wrong

ex.en: The punishment was extra work, not shame.
ex.zh: 惩罚是额外的作业，不是羞辱。

ex.en: A punishment that names a student in public teaches fear more than the rule.
ex.zh: 当众点名的惩罚，教给人的是害怕多于规则。

tip: punishment 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a way of thinking or feeling

ex.en: A positive attitude helps in hard times.
ex.zh: 积极态度有助于渡过难关。

ex.en: Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.
ex.zh: 学校可以给予学生建设性的反馈，而非不断批评，以培养积极的学习态度。

tip: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。

senses.en: to be likely to, or to look after

ex.en: Prices tend to rise in a dry month.
ex.zh: 干旱的月份价格往往会上涨。

ex.en: Nurses tend the clinic, and the school still needs a number on the wall.
ex.zh: 护士照料医务室，学校仍然需要把电话写在墙上。

tip: tend to do 表示倾向。照料用 tend somebody 或 tend to somebody。

senses.en: 12 o'clock at night

ex.en: The bus does not run after midnight.
ex.zh: 午夜之后这路公交不开。

ex.en: A club that ends at midnight still needs a way home.
ex.zh: 午夜才结束的社团仍然需要回家的办法。

tip: night 已在本库。at midnight 不加 the。

senses.en: a place for drinks, or a long piece

ex.en: There is a bar of soap by the sink.
ex.zh: 水槽边有一条肥皂。

ex.en: A snack bar at the school gate shapes what students eat more than a poster does.
ex.zh: 校门口的小吃店对学生吃什么的影响，大于一张海报。

tip: bar 的意思靠搭配区分：酒吧、条状物或栏杆。

senses.en: the act of choosing, or what is chosen

ex.en: You have a choice of two questions.
ex.zh: 你可以在两道题里选。

ex.en: A real choice of school exists only when a family can reach it by bus or on foot.
ex.zh: 只有当家庭能乘公交或步行到达时，择校才是真正的选择。

tip: choice 是名词；choose 是动词。

senses.en: to come back, or to give something back
the act of coming back

ex.en: Please return the book by Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五前还书。

ex.en: Young people return to a town when there is work, not only when they miss their family.
ex.zh: 年轻人回到城镇是因为有工作，而不只是因为想念家人。

tip: return 本身含“回”，不要说 return back。

senses.en: any person

ex.en: Anyone can borrow books with a library card.
ex.zh: 任何人有借书证都可以借书。

ex.en: Anyone planning a new road should ask the people who will walk beside it every day.
ex.zh: 任何计划修新路的人，都应该问问每天要在路边走的人。

tip: anyone 作主语时谓语用单数。疑问句和否定句比 someone 更常见。

senses.en: in a correct or suitable way

ex.en: Close the window properly.
ex.zh: 把窗户关严。

ex.en: A notice is useful only if the time is written properly.
ex.zh: 只有时间写对了，通知才有用。

tip: 形容词 proper 已在本库。properly 是它的副词。

senses.en: very pleasing to see or hear

ex.en: The lake looks beautiful in the morning.
ex.zh: 湖在早晨看起来很美。

ex.en: A beautiful old street can still be unsafe if cars park across the pavement.
ex.zh: 一条美丽的老街，如果汽车停满人行道，仍然可能不安全。

tip: beautiful 可形容人、景色或声音。

senses.en: a name that identifies a product

ex.en: The brand on the bag is not a reason to buy it.
ex.zh: 包上的品牌不是购买的理由。

ex.en: A famous brand can raise the price of a simple pencil far above its cost.
ex.zh: 名牌可以把一支普通铅笔的价格抬到成本之上很多。

tip: brand 是商业品牌。作动词可以是“打上烙印”。

senses.en: to rest and become less anxious

ex.en: Relax for ten minutes, then check the map.
ex.zh: 放松十分钟，然后核对地图。

ex.en: A room where students can relax still needs a clock.
ex.zh: 学生能放松的房间仍然需要一块钟。

tip: relax 可及物也可不及物。

senses.en: a feeling of shock, or an unexpected event
to make someone feel surprise

ex.en: The result was a surprise to the whole class.
ex.zh: 这个结果让全班都感到意外。

ex.en: A pleasant surprise still needs a plan if it changes the bus home.
ex.zh: 如果一件惊喜会改变回家的公交，它仍然需要安排。

col: to one surprise｜令某人吃惊的是
tip: surprised 形容人，surprising 形容事物。

senses.en: a situation, a legal matter, or a container

ex.en: In this case, we should ask the teacher.
ex.zh: 在这种情况下，我们应该问老师。

ex.en: In the case of a city flood, the first question is which roads still lead to the hospital.
ex.zh: 如果城市内涝，第一个问题是哪些路仍然通向医院。

tip: in case 后接句子，表示以防万一；in case of 后接名词。

senses.en: the warmest season

ex.en: The sports meet is in early summer.
ex.zh: 运动会在初夏举行。

ex.en: A hotter summer makes classrooms without fans harder places to learn.
ex.zh: 更热的夏天让没有风扇的教室更难学习。

tip: 季节前常用 in，不加 the：in summer。

senses.en: a number of people or things together

ex.en: Our group will present first.
ex.zh: 我们组第一个展示。

ex.en: A small group of volunteers can keep a community library open when the town budget is thin.
ex.zh: 当城镇预算紧张时，一小群志愿者也能维持社区图书馆开放。

tip: a group of 加复数名词时，谓语可随强调整体或成员而变化。

senses.en: a person who belongs to a group

ex.en: She is a member of the science club.
ex.zh: 她是科学社团的成员。

ex.en: Every member of a team should know who will speak if the plan fails.
ex.zh: 团队的每个成员都应该知道，如果计划失败由谁来说明。

tip: member 后常用 of，不用 in。

senses.en: an idea that explains facts

ex.en: The theory is simple, but the test is not.
ex.zh: 理论很简单，但实验并不简单。

ex.en: A theory about climate is useful only when students can see the measurements behind it.
ex.zh: 关于气候的理论，只有当学生能看到背后的测量数据时才有用。

tip: in theory 常和 in practice 对照。表里这一行的音标其实是 theoretical，本库改用 espeak。

senses.en: the soft part in the mouth used for tasting and speaking

ex.en: The doctor asked her to show her tongue.
ex.zh: 医生让她伸出舌头。

ex.en: A sharp tongue in a meeting teaches fear, not the bus time.
ex.zh: 会上尖刻的话教给人的是害怕，不是公交时间。

tip: mother tongue 是母语。a sharp tongue 比喻说话刻薄。

senses.en: an animal that lives in water
to try to catch fish

ex.en: The fish in this lake are protected.
ex.zh: 这个湖里的鱼受保护。

ex.en: If a river has no fish, the birds that feed on them leave the town as well.
ex.zh: 如果河里没有鱼，以鱼为食的鸟也会离开这座城镇。

tip: fish 单复数同形。表示一条鱼可用 a fish。

senses.en: a female child

ex.en: Her daughter studies at this school.
ex.zh: 她的女儿在这所学校上学。

ex.en: A daughter who wants to study engineering should see women doing that work.
ex.zh: 想学工程的女儿，应该看到有女性在做这份工作。

tip: daughter 的复数是 daughters。

senses.en: ready to attack or to push hard

ex.en: Aggressive talk does not fix the clock.
ex.zh: 强势的话修不好钟。

ex.en: An aggressive ad for a drink should not hang in the canteen.
ex.zh: 强推饮料的广告不应当挂在食堂。

tip: aggressive 可以形容人或做法。不要用来嘲笑同学。

senses.en: during the time that, or whereas
a period of time

ex.en: I listened to the recording while I washed the dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗时听了录音。

ex.en: Some cities invest in stadiums while their oldest school buildings still leak in the rain.
ex.zh: 一些城市投资体育场，而它们最老的校舍下雨时仍在漏水。

tip: while 可表示对比，相当于“而”；一段时间用 for a while。

senses.en: a place where children are educated

ex.en: Our school has a new science lab.
ex.zh: 我们学校有一间新的科学实验室。

ex.en: A school that stays open in the evening can give working parents a safe place for their children.
ex.zh: 晚上仍然开放的学校，可以为上班的父母提供一个孩子的安全去处。

tip: go to school 泛指上学，school 前通常不加 the。

senses.en: to move or act quickly
a sudden quick movement, or haste

ex.en: Do not rush onto a full bus.
ex.zh: 不要冲向满员的公交。

ex.en: Students who rush a lab step spill more than they save.
ex.zh: 赶实验步骤的学生洒出来的比省下的多。

tip: rush hour 是交通高峰。

senses.en: to lift, to increase, or to care for a child

ex.en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
ex.zh: 发言前请举手。

ex.en: Towns that raise bus fares should also say how students on free meals will travel.
ex.zh: 提高公交票价的城镇，也应当说明吃免费餐的学生怎么出行。

tip: raise 是及物动词。不及物的“上升”用 rise，已在本库。

senses.en: to put, arrange, or establish
a group of things that belong together

ex.en: Please set the chairs in a circle.
ex.zh: 请把椅子摆成一圈。

ex.en: If a school sets homework without time to sleep, the extra pages may lower the next day's attention.
ex.zh: 如果学校布置的作业挤掉了睡眠，多出来的页数可能会降低第二天的注意力。

tip: set 的过去式和过去分词都是 set。a set of 后接复数名词。

senses.en: to give food

ex.en: Who will feed the cat during the holiday?
ex.zh: 假期谁来喂猫？

ex.en: A canteen that can feed every student still needs a quiet table for those who eat slowly.
ex.zh: 能让每个学生吃上饭的食堂，仍然需要一张给吃得慢的人的安静桌子。

tip: feed 的过去式和过去分词是 fed。feed on 表示以……为食。

senses.en: school lessons in sport and exercise

ex.en: Physical education is on Tuesday afternoon.
ex.zh: 体育课在周二下午。

ex.en: Physical education needs a safe yard, not only a mark on the report.
ex.zh: 体育需要一个安全的场地，而不只是成绩单上的一个分数。

tip: 常缩写为 PE。形容词 physical 已在本库，本条保留全称，因为考纲里单独出现。

senses.en: clear and exact

ex.en: Please give a specific example.
ex.zh: 请给一个具体的例子。

ex.en: A specific date for opening the clinic matters more than a general promise.
ex.zh: 诊所开业的具体日期，比笼统的承诺更重要。

tip: specific 强调明确；special 强调特别。

senses.en: to feel sorry about something
a feeling of being sorry

ex.en: I regret the delay.
ex.zh: 我对这次延误感到遗憾。

ex.en: The town will regret a plan that ignores the last bus.
ex.zh: 忽视末班车的计划，城镇以后会后悔。

tip: regret doing 是后悔做过。regret to say 是遗憾地告诉你。也可作名词。

senses.en: at all times

ex.en: She always checks her answers twice.
ex.zh: 她总是把答案检查两遍。

ex.en: Towns that always build on the cheapest land may later discover that the ground floods.
ex.zh: 总在最便宜的土地上建设的城镇，日后可能会发现那块地会积水。

tip: always 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

senses.en: the sky, or a place of complete happiness in some religions

ex.en: The poem looks up at heaven.
ex.zh: 这首诗望向天空。

ex.en: Good heavens is an old phrase of surprise, not a fact about the sky.
ex.zh: Good heavens 是表示惊讶的旧说法，不是关于天空的事实。

tip: heaven 在宗教里常指天堂。文学里也可指天空。
